items.title: Using a strategic AI foresight team to stay ahead of the AI curve
items.summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is advancing at an unprecedented pace with breakthroughs and disruptions occurring almost weekly. From large language models to advanced automation systems with agentic AI, AI's impact is rapidly reshaping industries and redefining how businesses operate.

items.title: The path to targeted and sustainable generative AI
items.summary: As organizations move fast toward the use of generative AI, much has been written about common considerations to keep in mind when exploring and implementing this promising technology. Yet, what is often missing in this dialogue are two important considerations in the journey to generative AI: knowledge sovereignty and sustainability.

items.title: Why AI is more than generative AI
items.summary: Understanding that AI is more than just GenAI is critical to implementing effective solutions for your biggest challenges, not just AI for the sake of AI or endless proofs-of-concept across your business. GenAI on its own, without the right foundation and right context, does not deliver tangible outcomes. By getting to a baseline understanding, we can stop talking about AI and fully unlock how it can deliver business outcomes and value.
